User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the CocOs system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product available for sale.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

defaultPrice.description: Default price of the product (Level 1 Pricing Rule).

currentStock.description: Current stock level of the product.

unit.description: Unit of measure for the product (e.g., unit, case, gallon).

Batch.title: Batch
Batch.description: Represents a batch of products in inventory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Batch entity.

quantityRemaining.description: Remaining quantity of the product in this batch.

costPerUnit.description: Cost per unit for this batch.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the batch was received.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

address_data.description: Client's address data from Google Maps.

pricing_overrides.description: Client-specific pricing overrides (Level 2 Pricing Rule). Maps product ID to price.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a transaction (sale, restock, or waste).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

type.description: Type of transaction (sale, restock, or waste).

clientId.description: Reference to Client. (Relationship: Client 1:N Transaction). Nullable for restock/waste.

providerId.description: Reference to Provider. (Relationship: Provider 1:N Transaction). Nullable for sales/waste.

status.description: Status of the transaction (draft, delivered, paid).

items.description: Array of items included in the transaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Provider entity.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: Represents an item in a transaction.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product in this item.

appliedPrice.description: Final resolved price for this item.

pricingLevelUsed.description: Pricing level used to calculate the price (1, 2, or 3).

batchIdsDeducted.description: References to Batches deducted for this item. (Relationship: Batch N:N Item)

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the CocOs application's core features, including user authentication, inventory management, client management, sales & invoicing, and AI integration. The structure emphasizes authorization independence and supports QAPs by denormalizing authorization context and segregating data based on access needs.

**Authorization Independence:**

*   No `get()` calls are required in security rules.
*   Access control is determined solely by `request.auth.uid` and data within the document being accessed.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

*   Secure `list` operations are enabled through structural segregation.

**Structure:**

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores user profiles, including role information (admin or driver).
*   `/products/{productId}`: Stores product information, including default price and cost.
*   `/products/{productId}/batches/{batchId}`: Stores batch information for each product, enabling FIFO inventory management.
*   `/clients/{clientId}`: Stores client information, including pricing overrides.
*   `/transactions/{transactionId}`: Stores transaction data (sales, restocks, waste).
*   `/roles_admin/{userId}`: Indicates admin roles. Existence of a document grants admin access.

This structure enables simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules that scales with the application.
